Welcome to Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli

About the College

Walchand College of Engineering (WCE) is an autonomous institute located in Sangli, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1947, it is one of the premier engineering colleges in Maharashtra, affiliated with Shivaji University and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

The college offers undergraduate (B.E.), postgraduate (M.E./M.Tech.), and PhD programs across engineering, technology, and applied sciences disciplines.

Admissions 2025–26

Admissions to the B.E. program are through the Maharashtra Common Entrance Test (MHT-CET) or JEE Main scores, managed by the Centralised Admission Process (CAP) conducted by the State CET Cell.

Key Admission Dates:

  • MHT-CET 2025 registration deadline: 15 March 2025
  • CAP Round 1 merit list: 25 July 2025
  • CAP Round 1 admission confirmation: 28–31 July 2025
  • CAP Round 2 merit list: 10 August 2025
  • Institute-level admission (vacant seats): 25 August 2025

Students from reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/NT) are eligible for additional fee concessions as per Maharashtra government norms. Please refer to the official fee structure document for details.
